description: Epoch key set v2 (anet.enckeys/2): 15 epoch keys, one per UTC day from 2026-01-01, and a mailbox signing key; the L15 kids and the L16 signature by the owner's identity key; VerifyEncKeySet's content rules on the day, on day 14 and on day 15 and at the clock-skew edges; two sets accepted at a limit; one set per refusal class, each signed so that only its content fails; one changed byte that only the signature catches.
kel: none: the owner is a stand-in AID and an Ed25519 identity key; a verifier checks the signature with identity.public, and the KEL rules of VerifyEncKeySet are the KEL vectors' to pin

aid.rule: "b" + base32 lower without padding of 01 71 12 20 || seed(role)

accepted.name: keys_32
accepted.note: 32 keys, the most a set may hold

accepted.name: validity_two_days
accepted.note: the last key valid for exactly two days

flipped.note: the set with its last byte (inside the mbox public key) changed: it still decodes, but the signature no longer verifies

negatives.name: type_v1
negatives.note: key 0 is the v0.2 type anet.enckeys/1

negatives.name: unregistered_key_6
negatives.note: key 6, which the format does not name (CORE-G4: a key added)

negatives.name: key_64
negatives.note: key 64: a key set has no extension range

negatives.name: keys_33
negatives.note: 33 keys, one more than a set may hold

negatives.name: validity_three_days
negatives.note: the last key valid for three days

negatives.name: kid_mismatch
negatives.note: the fourth key's kid with its last bit changed, so it is not KID(suite, pub)

negatives.name: not_ascending
negatives.note: the third and fourth keys swapped

negatives.name: mbox_missing
negatives.note: key 5 removed (CORE-G4: a required key dropped)
